custody_risk: An operator captures material outside the approved pilot scope or later cannot show who requested the capture.
custody_floor: Record capture request, jurisdiction/election scope, authorized surfaces, excluded data, capture window, and approving role before collection.
required_records: capture request id; scope statement; approving role; capture window; prohibited-data list
reviewer_role: custody lead and election office sponsor
synthetic_status: synthetic custody floor only; no local capture authority recorded
public_boundary: Capture scope records what was authorized for collection; it is not a finding about outcome correctness or intent.
non_claims: not live authorization; not outcome certification; not proof of intent or fraud; not legal advice

custody_risk: Evidence cannot be attributed to a named role or role changes are hidden.
custody_floor: Record collector identity or role token, affiliation/COI note, training status, equipment owner, and whether the collector is acting as office staff, observer, contractor, or verifier.
required_records: collector role token; affiliation note; COI note; training check; equipment owner
public_boundary: Collector attribution supports accountability; it does not make a collector independent unless independence criteria are separately met.
non_claims: not proof of independence; not certification; not legal advice

custody_risk: A snapshot is unverifiable because capture method, tool version, time source, or vantage point is missing.
custody_floor: Record tool name/version, archive version, clock source, vantage point, network path class, and any capture limitations while minimizing private device and network identifiers.
required_records: tool version; archive version; time source; vantage class; limitation note
public_boundary: Capture environment describes how evidence was collected; it is not a claim that every audience saw the same artifact.
non_claims: not audience parity proof; not live evidence; not legal advice

custody_risk: A packet verifies today but lacks a lineage record tying payload bytes, manifest bytes, and generated reports.
custody_floor: Preserve payload digest, manifest digest, packet path, generated report digest, and any deterministic command used to rebuild or verify the packet.
required_records: payload digest; manifest digest; report digest; verification command; rebuild command if applicable
public_boundary: Digest lineage proves byte continuity within the recorded scope; it does not prove the contents are legally sufficient or true in every respect.
non_claims: not truth certification; not admissibility opinion; not legal advice

custody_risk: Evidence changes hands without a pre/post digest, timestamp, or receiving custodian.
custody_floor: For every handoff, record from-custodian, to-custodian, timestamp, artifact digest before transfer, artifact digest after transfer, storage medium, and exception if digest cannot be recomputed.
required_records: from custodian; to custodian; timestamp; pre-transfer digest; post-transfer digest; storage medium
synthetic_status: no local handoff records in archive
public_boundary: A custody transfer record preserves handling history; it does not certify that no prior capture or human error occurred.
non_claims: not tamper-proof guarantee; not certification; not legal advice

custody_risk: Reviewers, witnesses, or maintainers access evidence without bounded purpose, role, or time window.
custody_floor: Record who accessed each evidence family, role, purpose, access window, whether private fields were visible, and whether dissent or correction was filed.
required_records: access role; purpose; start/end time; private-field visibility; dissent pointer
reviewer_role: privacy reviewer and human review lead
public_boundary: Access logs support accountability and redaction review; they should not expose private voter, staff, witness, or security details.
non_claims: not public-records ruling; not legal advice; not live evidence

custody_risk: Private, privileged, safety-sensitive, or security-sensitive evidence is published because it is digest-verifiable.
custody_floor: Classify sealed/private fields, preserve private digest references, separate public derivatives, record reviewer approval, and document why any field stays withheld.
required_records: sensitivity class; private digest pointer; public derivative pointer; reviewer approval; withholding reason
reviewer_role: privacy reviewer counsel liaison and safety lead
public_boundary: A public derivative can prove that bytes were preserved without revealing every private field; withholding is not proof of wrongdoing.
non_claims: not public-release authorization; not public-records ruling; not legal advice

custody_risk: A public summary, quickstart, screenshot, or bulletin cannot be traced back to the private evidence it summarizes.
custody_floor: Record source evidence digest, redaction rule, accessibility/language review status, public artifact digest, publication channel, and correction/supersession pointer.
required_records: source digest; redaction rule; accessibility review status; public artifact digest; publication channel; correction pointer
reviewer_role: public release owner accessibility reviewer and communications owner
public_boundary: Public derivative lineage helps readers see what a public artifact is based on; it does not make the artifact current voter instruction.
non_claims: not current voter instruction; not accessibility certification; not legal advice

custody_risk: A forged screenshot, key-compromise event, outage, or safety report is changed, deleted, or over-summarized before preservation.
custody_floor: Freeze incident evidence with timestamp, capture method, evidence family, initial reviewer, non-claim boundary, and safe public sentence before later interpretation.
required_records: incident id; freeze timestamp; capture method; initial reviewer; non-claim boundary; safe public sentence
reviewer_role: incident communications owner and human review lead
public_boundary: Incident freezing preserves what was observed before interpretation; it does not prove motive, impact, or fraud.
non_claims: not proof of fraud; not proof of intent; not outcome certification; not legal advice

custody_risk: Offline verification succeeds but no transcript or custodian proves who ran it, with what ZIP, and what output was preserved.
custody_floor: Record release ZIP digest, verifier identity or role, offline machine description, transcript digest, extracted-tree manifest result, and storage location.
required_records: ZIP digest; verifier role; offline machine description; transcript digest; manifest result; storage location
synthetic_status: offline drill plan only; no live transcript
public_boundary: An offline transcript proves a verifier path ran for a named ZIP; it does not prove institutional independence unless reviewer identity and scope are recorded.
non_claims: not proof of independence; not certification; not legal advice

custody_risk: Source freshness, pinning, or demotion decisions cannot be attributed to a reviewer or byte snapshot.
custody_floor: Record source id, review date, reviewer role, pin hash when durable bytes are used, demotion/replacement reason, and downstream artifacts affected.
required_records: source id; review date; reviewer role; pin hash or demotion reason; affected artifacts
public_boundary: Source-review custody documents maintainer handling; it is not proof that any source is current public authority.
non_claims: not current authority; not legal advice; not voter instruction

custody_risk: Custody gaps, unresolved conflicts, reviewer dissent, or missing transfer fields are hidden to preserve a false sense of closure.
custody_floor: Record chain gaps, exception reason, responsible owner, reviewer dissent, public boundary sentence, and expiration/review date before relying on the evidence.
required_records: gap id; exception reason; owner; dissent pointer; boundary sentence; expiration date
reviewer_role: human review lead and records custodian
public_boundary: A chain-gap record makes uncertainty visible; it does not excuse overclaiming or prove misconduct.
non_claims: not proof of wrongdoing; not legal advice; not certification

custody_risk: Evidence is retained, sealed, returned, or destroyed without a digest, date, rule pointer, or accountable owner.
custody_floor: Record retention rule, disposition action, artifact digest, owner, date, private/public derivative status, and any legal hold or exception.
required_records: retention rule; disposition action; digest; owner; date; derivative status; hold/exception
public_boundary: Disposition records show what happened to evidence after review; they do not decide admissibility or public-records duties.
non_claims: not admissibility opinion; not public-records ruling; not legal advice

custody_risk: A release is promoted from synthetic to live use because packets verify, while custody, access, transfer, sealing, and disposition records are missing.
custody_floor: Keep live promotion no-go until every applicable custody row has local records, owners, reviewer approval, or a documented local exception.
required_records: local custody matrix; gap burndown; exceptions; reviewer approvals; no-go closure note
reviewer_role: release maintainer custody lead and election office sponsor
public_boundary: The custody gate keeps evidence handling explicit; it is not chain-of-custody certification and not legal advice.
non_claims: not chain-of-custody certification; not live authorization; not legal advice
